title: Home screen — the fan, four premium worlds
question: Same fan, same Day's end at the hub, no glow. Four materials that read expensive without stone. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Liquid glass
options.thesis: Clear glass segments with bright edges, refracting a soft ivory-to-rose light.
options.viewport: Light, airy fan over a warm glow; Day's end a thick glass lens.
options.risk: Glass is only as good as what is behind it; on a flat ground it goes grey.

options.label: Watch dial
options.thesis: The fan as a luxury watch face: brushed champagne metal, engraved hairlines, a chapter-ring of ticks.
options.viewport: Serif 'Quiet evening', a metal half-dial, Day's end a polished central cap.
options.risk: The most 'object'; a watch face can read as a gadget if it is overdone.

options.label: Editorial
options.thesis: No objects at all: hairlines, an elegant serif, numbered sectors, white space.
options.viewport: A drawn half-circle of hairlines with serif labels; tracked caps for the tab bar.
options.risk: Nothing to press; the fan has to feel tappable without any depth.

options.label: Embossed paper
options.thesis: One sheet of cotton paper, the fan blind-embossed into it, a gold-foil ring around Day's end.
options.viewport: Textured ivory sheet, raised fan, foil-ringed seal at the hub.
options.risk: Paper texture must stay very fine, or it turns rustic.
